facts.fact: Subscribers: 17,425 at 2025-06, per the Communications Authority of Kenya (Q4 sector statistics, April-June 2025), 0.8% of the fixed internet market.
Subscribers: 17,066 at 2025-03, per the Communications Authority of Kenya (Q3 sector statistics, January-March 2025), 0.9% share.
Starlink launched in Kenya in 2023 and sells satellite internet to households and businesses there; equipment costs Sh28,000 to Sh45,000.
